verdict.rationale: LlamaParse's own parse examples list "batch processing" among documented workflows, so the product does document processing many documents together. That is only a single thin mention, with no detail on batch API semantics, limits, or bulk operations beyond parsing. Reusable classification configs across jobs (docs-39) are an adjacent feature and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented batch/bulk API endpoints and limits, bulk operations for Extract/Classify/Split, bulk status or result management, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: custom prompts, batch processing, spreadsheets, and TypeScript/Node.js integration
